Code: In some homes the agent reminded the caregiver
Definition: Where a caregiver gives the medicine, the agent's first user is the caregiver. Lived.
Sub-theme: Mostly It Reminded Me: The Caregiver as First Principal
Theme: The Agent as the Caregiver's Own Tool
Example quote: \"Mostly it reminded me, because I am the one managing their medicines. If I am busy doing household work, the reminder helps me remember that it is time.\" (C05, Phase 2, L17)

Code: The agent said whom it works for, and that was clear
Definition: Hearing the agent state whom it served was odd at first, then helpful. Lived.
Sub-theme: Legibility of Whom the Agent Serves
Theme: The Agent as the Caregiver's Own Tool
Example quote: \"It did not feel like it was secretly doing something. I knew what information was being shared.\" (C03, Phase 2, L17)

Code: Letting family in is trust, not losing independence
Definition: Family already knows and helps; letting the agent tell them changes nothing about who takes the medicine. Elicited.
Sub-theme: Legibility of Whom the Agent Serves
Theme: The Agent as the Caregiver's Own Tool
Example quote: \"If there is something important, like someone missed medicine, then I think family should know. We already remind each other normally. So sharing that kind of thing is not a big problem.\" (C02, Phase 2, L20)

Code: It became the family's when my child started checking it
Definition: The agent became shared through a kin's checking or listening, not through setup. Lived.
Sub-theme: Shared When They Started Listening
Theme: The Agent as the Caregiver's Own Tool
Example quote: \"Earlier I was thinking I will set it up for them and then leave it. But after using it, my mother started listening for the reminder and my father also knew that if he does not confirm then I may get a notification. So it became more of a family thing.\" (C03, Phase 2, L29)

Code: Tell the one who knows or is at home
Definition: Direction goes to one person, chosen by knowledge, presence, or role. Hypothetical.
Sub-theme: My Place in the Circle, One Person, When She Agrees
Theme: The Agent as the Caregiver's Own Tool
Example quote: \"A normal reminder can stay with the person taking the medicine and me. If there are repeated missed medicines, a wrong medicine, or some change that needs attention, then it should come to the family.\" (C01, Phase 2, L124)

Code: Only if I agree
Definition: The older adult's consent is the condition for telling family. Hypothetical.
Sub-theme: My Place in the Circle, One Person, When She Agrees
Theme: The Agent as the Caregiver's Own Tool
Example quote: \"When the person using it agrees. In our case my mother is okay with me knowing if she misses a medicine because I already help her. But I don't think it should automatically tell the whole family everything.\" (C04, Phase 2, L189)

Code: Tell family only about a real miss, silence, or empty stock
Definition: Family is not told every dose. Elicited, hypothetical.
Sub-theme: My Place in the Circle, One Person, When She Agrees
Theme: The Agent as the Caregiver's Own Tool
Example quote: \"My parents for the medicine itself. But for the family notification, it should consider both. I don't want information about them coming to me unnecessarily, but I do want to know when there is a real problem.\" (C03, Phase 2, L181)

Code: Give me a first chance, remind again, then tell one person
Definition: The accepted escalation: not too fast, not silent. Mostly hypothetical.
Sub-theme: My Place in the Circle, One Person, When She Agrees
Theme: The Agent as the Caregiver's Own Tool
Example quote: \"It should remind again after some time. Sometimes my mother forgets, so one reminder may not be enough. If there is still no response, then maybe it can inform me.\" (C01, Phase 2, L40)

Code: For me first, then for both of us
Definition: Everyone said both, the older adult first. Elicited.
Sub-theme: My Place in the Circle, One Person, When She Agrees
Theme: The Agent as the Caregiver's Own Tool
Example quote: \"I think all of us, in a way. It helps me because I am the one mostly managing the medicine. But the main purpose is helping my parents and my aunty take their medicine properly.\" (C01, Phase 2, L116)

Code: The caregiver no longer watches the clock
Definition: Less calling, less worrying, no sudden thought at work. Lived.
Sub-theme: Relieved of the Clock, the Calling, and the Intrusive Thought
Theme: Less Pressure, Not Less Responsibility
Example quote: \"I don't keep watching the clock for their medicine. I can focus on my work. If something needs my attention, then I get the notification.\" (C03, Phase 2, L165)

Code: The phone reminds first now; family asks less but still asks
Definition: The first reminder moved to the agent; routine asking fell away. Lived.
Sub-theme: The First Reminder Moved, the Asking Remained Care
Theme: Less Pressure, Not Less Responsibility
Example quote: \"Earlier we mostly depended on memory and family members reminding each other. Now the agent can remind them directly. So there is less need for me to keep asking every time.\" (C02, Phase 2, L56)

Code: Family asking is care, even when it annoys
Definition: Kin asking is care; the agent cannot replace that feeling. Elicited.
Sub-theme: The First Reminder Moved, the Asking Remained Care
Theme: Less Pressure, Not Less Responsibility
Example quote: \"I still check. I just don't have to do it for every medicine time. So it reduces some work, but it doesn't mean we stop caring.\" (C02, Phase 2, L60)

Code: The notification gives family a reason to talk
Definition: The alert becomes a question, not a report. Lived, elicited.
Sub-theme: The First Reminder Moved, the Asking Remained Care
Theme: Less Pressure, Not Less Responsibility
Example quote: \"Now if the assistant shows something different, we talk about it instead of just ignoring it. We check what the latest instruction is.\" (C03, Phase 2, L105)

Code: Less pressure, not less responsibility
Definition: The agent helps without taking the family out. Lived, elicited.
Sub-theme: The First Reminder Moved, the Asking Remained Care
Theme: Less Pressure, Not Less Responsibility
Example quote: \"Now there is a proper reminder and someone can know if a dose was missed. I think it reduces the pressure on the family without removing the family from it.\" (C03, Phase 2, L205)

Code: Family noticed the streak and praised it
Definition: The streak became a small family topic. Lived.
Sub-theme: The Streak as Ours, Sometimes Mine
Theme: Less Pressure, Not Less Responsibility
Example quote: \"At first I thought it was a little funny. But then it became something we noticed. If my father had a good streak, we would say okay, you are doing well.\" (C03, Phase 2, L117)

Code: A broken streak means check why; medicine is not a game
Definition: The count is a record to check, not a loss. Hypothetical.
Sub-theme: The Streak as Ours, Sometimes Mine
Theme: Less Pressure, Not Less Responsibility
Example quote: \"I would not want that to make my mother anxious. Sometimes people forget. We should understand why it happened and make sure it doesn't happen again. The score should not become more stressful than the medicine itself.\" (C01, Phase 2, L84)

Code: Encouragement yes, pressure no
Definition: Sharing the score is fine for encouragement, not for monitoring or competition. Elicited.
Sub-theme: The Streak as Ours, Sometimes Mine
Theme: Less Pressure, Not Less Responsibility
Example quote: \"If it says everything is on track, that is good. Family also gives encouragement sometimes. But medicine is not a competition.\" (C02, Phase 2, L80)

Code: Family may see the score; nobody outside
Definition: Privacy starts beyond the family. Elicited.
Sub-theme: The Streak as Ours, Sometimes Mine
Theme: Less Pressure, Not Less Responsibility
Example quote: \"Basic progress can be shared with family. Since I am helping them, it is useful for me to know. But every small detail does not need to be shown to everyone.\" (C01, Phase 2, L88)

Code: A second memory, not a replacement
Definition: The reminder reinforces timing; people still know; some still forget. Elicited.
Sub-theme: Habituation Seen From Outside
Theme: Less Pressure, Not Less Responsibility
Example quote: \"The medicine time feels more fixed now. My mother also seems to expect the reminder.\" (C04, Phase 2, L169)

Code: No answer means busy, not forgotten
Definition: Silence is work, deferral, not hearing, or a forgotten press. Lived.
Sub-theme: No Confirmation as a Signal to Check
Theme: Signals, Not Verdicts: Reading Silence and the Record
Example quote: \"Not immediately. First remind me again. I might have given the medicine but forgotten to confirm it. If there is still no response, then the family can be informed.\" (C06, Phase 2, L39)

Code: Do not assume a miss; a person should check first
Definition: The record is below the act; a family member's question settles it. Lived, hypothetical.
Sub-theme: No Confirmation as a Signal to Check
Theme: Signals, Not Verdicts: Reading Silence and the Record
Example quote: \"But if there was a difference, I would check what actually happened before trusting the record.\" (C05, Phase 2, L93)

Code: A false alarm worries family for nothing
Definition: Telling family of a miss that did not happen is the feared failure. Hypothetical.
Sub-theme: A False Alarm as the Failure
Theme: Signals, Not Verdicts: Reading Silence and the Record
Example quote: \"Also, if it keeps telling the family something was missed when it was actually given, that would become a problem because everyone would start worrying unnecessarily.\" (C06, Phase 2, L55)

Code: Wrong information was checked, not accepted
Definition: A caregiver found mismatches and verified them. Lived.
Sub-theme: Mismatches Checked and Warnings That Explain
Theme: Signals, Not Verdicts: Reading Silence and the Record
Example quote: \"Not for a normal reminder. But there were times when something did not match what we knew from the prescription. Then I would check it instead of just accepting it.\" (C03, Phase 2, L49)

Code: A warning must say why
Definition: Caregivers want the reason, not just a loud alert. Hypothetical.
Sub-theme: Mismatches Checked and Warnings That Explain
Theme: Signals, Not Verdicts: Reading Silence and the Record
Example quote: \"But it should explain what the problem is. Just giving a big warning without telling me why would not be very helpful.\" (C01, Phase 2, L36)

Code: The doctor decides; the agent only reminds
Definition: The prescription or notes are the authority; the agent never guesses. Hypothetical.
Sub-theme: The Doctor Decides, a Person Confirms
Theme: Keeping the Agent Below the Doctor and Current With the Prescription
Example quote: \"We have had a situation before where my father had a problem with a medicine and the doctor changed it. So for those things, I would not depend only on an app.\" (C01, Phase 2, L64)

Code: I must be able to stop a wrong reminder
Definition: Stop it, check the paper, never take an extra tablet. Hypothetical.
Sub-theme: The Doctor Decides, a Person Confirms
Theme: Keeping the Agent Below the Doctor and Current With the Prescription
Example quote: \"I would check the prescription first. If it does not match what the doctor said, then I would not follow the system blindly.\" (C01, Phase 2, L32)

Code: After a change, the agent is wrong until someone updates it
Definition: Old schedules kept reminding until updated. Lived, hypothetical.
Sub-theme: Stale Until Updated; Tell Everyone What Changed
Theme: Keeping the Agent Below the Doctor and Current With the Prescription
Example quote: \"I would believe the doctor after checking the prescription. I would also update the assistant. The assistant can be wrong if the prescription changed.\" (C03, Phase 2, L101)

Code: Everyone must be told what changed and why
Definition: Otherwise the wife reminds of the old medicine and the son buys the old one. Elicited, hypothetical.
Sub-theme: Stale Until Updated; Tell Everyone What Changed
Theme: Keeping the Agent Below the Doctor and Current With the Prescription
Example quote: \"Especially if it is something important. If the doctor changes a medicine, then we should know what changed and why.\" (C02, Phase 2, L68)

Code: I tested it against my routine or my papers
Definition: Reminders were compared with routine, alarm, notes, or prescription before trusting. Lived.
Sub-theme: Trust After My Own Check, and Through Her Response
Theme: Keeping the Agent Below the Doctor and Current With the Prescription
Example quote: \"If it keeps giving the correct medicine and correct timing, then slowly I would trust it. But I would still keep the prescription because that is our main reference.\" (C01, Phase 2, L100)

Code: My child set it and checked it, so I trust it
Definition: Trust came through the kin who configured it. Lived.
Sub-theme: Trust After My Own Check, and Through Her Response
Theme: Keeping the Agent Below the Doctor and Current With the Prescription
Example quote: \"Once the reminders were coming at the correct time and my mother was actually responding to them, I started trusting the normal routine more.\" (C04, Phase 2, L153)

Code: A voice with the name, simple and quiet
Definition: Sound suits non-readers and busy people; the score is not for them. Elicited.
Sub-theme: A Voice With the Name, and Not Another Job
Theme: Keeping the Agent Below the Doctor and Current With the Prescription
Example quote: \"My parents can use smartphones, but they are not comfortable with every new app. So if the reminder is clear, maybe voice also, and it tells them which medicine and when, then that is enough.\" (C01, Phase 2, L132)

Code: The phone does not know if I have eaten
Definition: Family knows the situation; the phone knows only what is entered. Lived, elicited.
Sub-theme: A Voice With the Name, and Not Another Job
Theme: Keeping the Agent Below the Doctor and Current With the Prescription
Example quote: \"Together with the family. The system can remind us, but we still know the actual situation at home. If something changes, we need to check the prescription and understand what happened.\" (C06, Phase 2, L23)

Code: Wrong information, noise, or extra work ends use
Definition: Caregivers stop if it becomes another job. Hypothetical.
Sub-theme: A Voice With the Name, and Not Another Job
Theme: Keeping the Agent Below the Doctor and Current With the Prescription
Example quote: \"If it gives wrong medicine information, sends too many unnecessary alerts, or makes changes without us knowing. Also if I have to keep entering everything manually every day. That would become another job.\" (C03, Phase 2, L189)
